headline: Expensive crude fuels investment at Petrobras
summary: Petrobras's new 2027-2031 investment budget exceeds the $109 billion in the previous plan. The increase is linked to higher crude oil prices, according to the source.
why: Petrobras is Brazil's state-controlled oil company and one of the largest producers in deepwater oil. Its investment plans shape output growth and dividend capacity for shareholders.

impacts.name: Petrobras
impacts.why: A larger capital budget signals expanded spending, linked in the input to higher crude prices.
